caption:
One day. One campaign. $5.6 million raised for India. Not from a government fund. From the diaspora, one donation at a time.

In March 2026, India Giving Day raised $5.6 million in a single day for 51 Indian nonprofits - four times what the very first campaign raised in 2023 ($1.4 million).

The money funds nonprofits working on women and girls, healthcare, rural development, clean water and digital literacy - not one cause, dozens. Most donors are young, first-time givers, driven by peer-to-peer fundraisers rather than large institutional checks.

India's diaspora nearly doubled from 18 to 35 million people between 2019 and 2024 - this kind of giving is only getting started.

This isn't charity from a distance. It's people who left choosing, every year, to build back into the place they came from.

Sources: India Philanthropy Alliance, South Asian Herald, Indiaspora (2025-2026)
